format: WSDC Jack and Jill callback and final scoring

source.quote_free_summary: WSDC Jack and Jill contests use the WSDC-approved Callback system for preliminaries and the Relative Placement system for finals; preliminary callback values and tie handling are set in Section 5, while the finals algorithm is defined off-document on the WSDC website.

requirement: WSDC preliminary callback scoring and finals Relative Placement are distinct systems. DanceFlow does not represent Studio ordinal ballots (or the Studio callback tally) as WSDC-compatible; no WSDC engine or ballot format exists. NOT IMPLEMENTED for a future WSDC profile.
enforcement_point: Not built. NOT IMPLEMENTED; a blocker for activating the corresponding future governing-body profile. Studio/Custom behavior is unchanged.

tests.name: REGISTERED_ENGINES and STUDIO_ENGINES hold exactly the two Studio engines
